selection: all five metadata-only, default-sublocation 8--14-year stream candidates in source-unseen HUC2 regions 13/20, excluding reservoir/lake/pond/canal/ditch/tunnel/outfall names
annual_target: H30 from agency approved daily mean Celsius
analysis: source-fixed annual comparison and descriptive selected risk; unregistered; HUC13 treated as one connected region; no broad risk or new-climate guarantee
qualification_extension: Retain all original five candidates and add both source-unseen metadata candidates with 4--7 supported years, matching the unchanged minimum of four complete reference years. No masked reconstruction errors have been inspected.
additional_station_check: Three metadata-selected, previously unmeasured stations from HUC2 03/08/12 are added as a separate station holdout check. They are not new source-unseen climate regions. No reconstruction errors have been evaluated; all ten qualification results are retained. Stop recruitment at ten candidates.
final_analysis_scope: Observation-only corroboration of the paper's primary record-omission claim on all ten acquired candidates; original four-complete-year reconstruction-reference criterion remains unchanged and no candidate qualifies. No imputer is fitted or scored. Approved contiguous windows are compared against all approved-complete reference years, including references not retained by extra heuristic QC.
registration: Unregistered exploratory corroboration; no preregistered or blind confirmation claim.
